episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the power of incremental improvement and consistency in content creation for real estate agents. He shares insights on leveraging social media platforms like Instagram and TikTok, as well as the untapped potential of YouTube for generating leads. The conversation also touches on using AI tools for recruitment and the importance of maintaining viewer engagement to increase content reach.
